verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice is invoicing and billing SaaS, not an AI agent or AI host application, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product role. Nothing in the evidence shows an embedded agent or MCP client capability that would make this axis apply; the REST API, OAuth and Zoho integrations are unrelated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
